name: Braintree Town Centre
notes: Made on 3 August 2023, when the council divided the Braintree Town Centre and Bradford Street conservation area (designated 19 June 1969) into two areas with revised boundaries (London Gazette notice 4494448). The PDP holds only the former combined area (entity 44005701), which should be ended. The council's directory still shows the combined area.
